title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD together
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for CKD and T2DM.

HPI
Pt is a 56-year-old female presenting for routine f/u of chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes. Pt reports adherence to diet-only management for glucose control. Denies any acute symptoms, edema, or changes in urinary output. Reports stable energy levels.

Medication List
Dietary modifications only.

Exam
Vitals: BP 124/78, HR 72, Temp 98.6F.
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation.
Ext: No edema noted.
Skin: Intact, no lesions.

Assessment
1. CKD stage 3a: Recent labs show eGFR of 52. Stable at this time.
2. T2DM: Managed with diet alone.

Plan
1. Continue current diet for glucose management.
2. Monitor renal function with f/u labs in 3 months.
3. Patient to maintain hydration and continue monitoring for any symptoms of renal decline.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
05/14/2026
explanations: Type 2 diabetes and CKD are linked by the 'with' convention unless the provider says otherwise: E11.22 (HCC 37).
The CKD stage is coded in addition: N18.31.

distractors.why: The 'with' convention presumes the diabetes caused the CKD.
E11.22 says to use an additional code for the CKD stage.
